title: Eviction of tenant before Rent Controller
verbatim_text: (1) A landlord seeking to evict his tenant shall apply to the Controller for an order in that behalf only on the grounds of: (a) default in payment of rent within sixty days; (b) subletting without written consent; (c) personal bona fide need of the landlord or his children.
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance, 2001
